description: Burgers with cheese, lettuce and tomato on a balloon: two stations back to back sharing a sink and the bun crate, ringed by a corridor with the plates and the serving counter. Fires break out on the floor at random and block the way until put out.
strategy: The right chef builds the burgers and takes dirty plates to the sink; the left chef passes cheese and tomato across, washes up and serves. Keep someone near the extinguisher: a floor fire can corner a chef.
